decks.notes: This deck revolves around using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a control finisher, supported by cards like Bring to Light, Leyline Binding, and Vanishing Verse to control the game. The deck also leverages the versatility of Omnath, Locus of Creation and Nahiri, the Harbinger for additional value and removal options. The inclusion of various triomes and fetch lands allows for consistent mana fixing, while Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value through blinking key permanents. The deck aims to outvalue and outcontrol opponents through its wide range of options and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cheap spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck includes a mix of cantrips and card draw spells to help consistently trigger Arclight Phoenix's ability. Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder provide additional graveyard synergies while Brazen Borrower offers a versatile threat. Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal options, while Spell Pierce helps protect your creatures and disrupt opposing strategies. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to red and blue mana sources.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Moon-Circuit Hacker and Mockingbird to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. By disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and utilizing removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to maintain board control. Faerie Miscreant and Brazen Borrower provide additional utility and evasion. The deck also includes some land synergy with Gloomlake Verge to ensure consistent mana production. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruption in order to secure victory.

The deck focuses on using the Jegantha companion to make it easier to cast multiple creatures in a turn and take advantage of powerful enter-the-battlefield effects from creatures like Atraxa and Rona. With cards like Collected Company and Kinnan, the deck can quickly flood the board with creatures and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes key lands like Boseiju to protect against counter spells and Plaza of Heroes to provide additional value when creatures enter the battlefield. Overall, the deck aims to generate a strong board presence and outpace the opponent with its combo potential.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells and then use cards like Treasure Cruise and Arclight Phoenix to quickly bring them back to the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster to disrupt the opponent's hand and strategy, while cards like Spell Pierce and Fiery Impulse help to control the board. The inclusion of powerful lands like Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional advantages in this aggressive deck, allowing for strong, explosive plays.

The focus of this deck is to dominate the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy through hand disruption with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence with creatures like Bloodletter of Aclazotz and Unstoppable Slasher, and eventually close out the game with powerful finishers like Sheoldred's Edict and Graveyard Trespasser. The inclusion of Mutavault and Castle Locthwain provide additional utility and card advantage to maintain control throughout the game.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also efficiently dealing with threats on the board using removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck aims to control the game by denying the opponent resources and eventually winning with powerful finishers like Reckoner Bankbuster and Bloodletter of Aclazotz. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Field of Ruin to further support its game plan.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on playing fast and aggressive creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to quickly establish a board presence. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria disrupt opponents' plans by taxing their spells. Collected Company helps to find more creatures quickly. Skyclave Apparition and Elite Spellbinder provide removal and disruption. The deck also includes cards like Enduring Innocence and Virtue of Loyalty to protect and buff creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a strong, efficient creature base and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources through hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also managing the board with removal spells such as Heartless Act and Fatal Push. It utilizes powerful threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Unstoppable Slasher to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. The deck also has a strong mid-range game plan with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and provide flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently tutor for powerful creature cards while controlling the opponent's board with removal spells and Leyline Binding. The deck aims to establish a board presence with high-value creatures like Angel of Serenity and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Skyclave Apparition and Portable Hole. By effectively managing resources and utilizing the enchantment's ability to search for specific creatures, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for repeated attacks. It utilizes cards like Consider, Treasure Cruise, and Opt to draw cards and fill the graveyard, while also including removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to control the board. The deck also includes some counter spells like Spell Pierce to protect key cards and maintain pressure on the opponent. The overall strategy is to be aggressive and constantly apply pressure with Arclight Phoenix and other creatures.

This mono black control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through targeted discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also using removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse to deal with threats on the board. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodletter of Aclazotz to pressure the opponent. The mana base is optimized for consistency, with lands like Mutavault and Godless Shrine providing flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to control the game tempo and outvalue the opponent with efficient removal and threats.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenix and other spells, then use spells like Consider, Sleight of Hand, and Opt to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for repeated aggressive attacks. The deck also contains various spells for control and disruption, such as Fiery Impulse, Stormcarved Coast, and Spell Pierce. The inclusion of cards like Artist's Talent and Picklock Prankster helps maintain tempo and card advantage, while cards like Treasure Cruise provide additional card draw to keep up the pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing spirits to quickly apply pressure on opponents while controlling the board with counterspells and removal. The key strategy is to tempo out opponents by deploying threats like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller while protecting them with cards like Rattlechains and Supreme Phantom. Skyclave Apparition and Mutavault provide additional disruption and versatility, allowing the deck to adapt to various situations. The inclusion of Enduring Curiosity and No More Lies helps maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on opponents throughout the game.

The deck aims to combine the cards Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Transmogrify, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to cheat powerful creatures into play and overwhelm opponents. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the game while using cards like Case of the Stashed Skeleton to recur key threats. The inclusion of cards like Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion and additional red burn spells provides versatility and alternate win conditions, making the deck a deadly and unpredictable force in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control elements such as hand disruption, removal spells, and land destruction to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board control. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Bloodletter of Aclazotz and Unstoppable Slasher helps to apply pressure on the opponent while cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Invoke Despair provide additional value. The mana base is optimized for consistency and efficiency, with options for both aggression and resilience. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the game through strategic plays and resource management.
